_comment: Illegal corpus, ELECTRICAL / CONSISTENCY half. Same shape as format.json:
one minimal tampering per variant; expect lists the finding ids the real gates print
(verified with `node test/corpus.js --probe`). Cascades are listed too — a renamed
power net breaks both the netlist diff and the PCB agreement, and the manifest says so.
ERC: E000 no sheets, E001 unconnected pin, E002 single-pin net, E003 netlist differs from
the design, E004 duplicate designator, E005 part missing from the PCB, E006 PCB pad net
disagrees with the schematic. DRC: D001 spacing, D004 net not fully routed, D007 pad without
a net. LINT: L003 non-orthogonal wire, L004 wire crosses a symbol, L008 off the grid.
expect.leak = recorded blind spot (nothing reports); expect.crash = recorded robustness gap.

illegal.name: pcb-padnet-against-schematic
illegal.title: a pad wired to the wrong net: the board says GND where the schematic says V_LED
illegal.mutate: flip the padNet of the C1 pad the design puts on V_LED

illegal.name: pcb-padnet-net-blank
illegal.title: a pad left without a net while the schematic drives it
illegal.mutate: clear padNet on the V_LED pad of C1

illegal.name: schematic-wire-segment-dropped
illegal.title: one segment of a two-segment wire deleted: the net still connects, the copper is gone
illegal.mutate: drop the last LINE segment of the wire labelled LED_A
illegal.suggest: a WIRE whose body carries no surviving LINE segment (or whose segment count shrinks) is invisible to every gate — connectivity-only reasoning cannot see it

illegal.name: schematic-wire-and-label-gone
illegal.title: the whole LED_A wire deleted: two pins land on nothing, the net disappears
illegal.mutate: remove the WIRE carrying LED_A together with its LINEs and attrs

illegal.name: schematic-part-moved-off-its-net
illegal.title: R1 nudged 37 mil right: both pads dangle and LED_A keeps a single pin
illegal.mutate: move the R1 COMPONENT body.x by +37

illegal.name: power-flag-net-renamed
illegal.title: the VCC power flag names a net the net table does not carry
illegal.mutate: set the VCC Global Net Name attr to VCC_5V

illegal.name: power-flag-net-collides-with-ground
illegal.title: the VCC flag renamed to GND — a supply flag feeding the ground net
illegal.mutate: set the VCC Global Net Name attr to GND

illegal.name: duplicate-designator
illegal.title: two components labelled D1
illegal.mutate: rename the C1 Designator attr to D1

illegal.name: part-missing-from-pcb
illegal.title: R1 placed in the schematic but deleted from the board
illegal.mutate: remove the R1 component record with its attrs and PAD_NETs

illegal.name: schematic-part-missing-from-netlist
illegal.title: R1 removed from the schematic while it is still on the board
illegal.mutate: remove the R1 component record with all its attrs

illegal.name: pcb-net-left-unrouted
illegal.title: every track and via of LED_A erased — two pads, no copper
illegal.mutate: delete all LINE/VIA records whose netName is LED_A

illegal.name: pcb-track-net-retagged
illegal.title: a routed track relabelled to another net: clearance and continuity both wake up
illegal.mutate: rename the net of the first LED_A track to GND

illegal.name: schematic-wire-skewed
illegal.title: a wire segment bent off the orthogonal grid
illegal.mutate: shift the first sheet wire LINE by +7 mil in Y
